proof_body:
by
  intro R A _ _ _ N x hN h1 hx
  have : Module.Finite R N := Module.Finite.iff_fg.2 hN
  let φ : Module.End R N := LinearMap.restrict (LinearMap.mulLeft R x) hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp, h0⟩ := LinearMap.exists_monic_and_aeval_eq_zero R φ
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  have hpow : ∀ (k : ℕ) (n : N), (((φ ^ k) n : N) : A) = x ^ k * n := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro n; simp
    | succ k ih =>
      intro n
      rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, pow_succ', mul_assoc, ← ih n]
      rfl
  have key : ∀ (q : Polynomial R) (n : N), ((Polynomial.aeval φ q n : N) : A) = Polynomial.aeval x q * n := by
    intro q n
    induction q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add a b ha hb => simp [ha, hb, add_mul]
    | monomial k r =>
      simp only [Polynomial.aeval_monomial, Module.End.mul_apply]
      rw [mul_assoc, ← hpow k n]
      simp [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, Algebra.smul_def]
  have := key p ⟨1, h1⟩
  rw [h0] at this
  have h2 : (Polynomial.aeval x) p = 0 := by simpa using this.symm
  simpa [Polynomial.aeval_def] using h2
target_source: ∀ (R A : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] (N : Submodule R A) (x : A), N.FG → (1 : A) ∈ N → (∀ n ∈ N, x * n ∈ N) → IsIntegral R x
